decision_question: Is this portable synthetic-data skill ready for a supervised, reviewable release?
criteria: exact role and attributable source evidence
portable structure and meaningful development cases

claim_ledger.claim: Role, customer, and candidate claims remain distinguishable
claim_ledger.status: supported by static review, not behavioral execution

claim_ledger.claim: The skill supports one-question practice and useful grounded cues
claim_ledger.status: supported by static review, not behavioral execution

claim_ledger.claim: Privacy and untrusted input boundaries are present
claim_ledger.status: supported by static review, not penetration testing

reviews.initial: Low severity: source verification could imply independent corroboration.
reviews.revision: Attribution language and conflicting-source case added; reviewer found issue resolved.

reviews.initial: Medium: practice flow and positive coaching checks insufficient; low: triggering and source attribution.
reviews.revision: Practice default, positive and two-turn cases, attribution and trigger updated; reviewer found material issues resolved.

reviews.initial: No material finding in static review.
reviews.revision: No new material finding in static re-review.

reviews.reason: Initial reviews differed materially in findings; conditional protocol routes directly to adjudication.

reviews.result: Implemented evidence and outcome findings; accepted re-reviews with same-model correlation and static limits.

limitations: Synthetic cases are a design, not executed outcomes.
Independent contexts share a model family and source package.
No live host activation, real-candidate test, protected holdout, or performance uplift is established.

follow_up.next: Execute isolated with/without-skill development cases and an unseen external holdout; verify host discovery and installations.
follow_up.expiry_trigger: Material skill changes, new execution evidence, host changes, or user-discovered failure.
